changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.30[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: Gemini and OMDb setup wizards[/COLOR]
-Settings > Accounts (Meta) has a Gemini Setup Wizard and an OMDb Setup Wizard. Scan the QR on the TV, paste your key on your phone or computer and it is saved in luc_kodi, with no typing on the TV. Typing or pasting it with the Kodi keyboard is still there.
-Every key is checked before it is saved, with a call that uses no quota. A key that does not work is not saved, and the phone and the TV say why (not valid, blocked by Google, OMDb key not activated yet...). A valid key with no quota left for now is saved.
-Gemini: up to five keys at once. If you already have some, add the new ones to the free slots or replace them all. Nothing is removed unless at least one new key works.
-AI Search without a Gemini key now offers the wizard instead of only showing a notice.
[COLOR fffdb515]Safer setup wizards[/COLOR]
-Every setup wizard that opens a page on your home network (AIOStreams, Comet, Torz, Sootio, Meteor, Newznab, MDBList, Custom Badges, Gemini and OMDb) now has a short one-time code in its address. The QR on the TV carries it, so nothing changes when you scan it; if you type the address by hand, add the six letters after the last slash.
-Without the code the page does not open and nothing can be sent to Kodi, so another device on the same network cannot reach the wizard while it is waiting.
-The setup pages never show keys or accounts already saved. AIOStreams no longer shows a saved manifest URL (it carries your account): it says that one is saved; leave the box empty to keep it.
[COLOR fffdb515]luc_kodi Home: Add-ons stays on the menu[/COLOR]
-Nimbus, Nimbus Plus, FENtastic, FENtastic Plus and Estuary MOD V2 now keep the skin's Add-ons entry when luc_kodi Home is applied, so your installed add-ons are one click away from the Home.
-If a previous luc_kodi Home hid it, applying luc_kodi Home again brings it back. Restore my previous Home still leaves it as it was before the first time.
